constellation website animated background

        color: "\#ffffff",

        width: 1  
      },  
      move: {  
        enable: true,  
        speed: 1, /\* Slow, drifting celestial movement \*/  
        direction: "none",  
        random: true,  
        straight: false,  
        out\_mode: "out"  
      }  
    },  
    interactivity: {  
      detect\_on: "canvas",  
      events: {  
        onhover: { enable: true, mode: "grab" }, /\* Connects lines to mouse \*/  
        onclick: { enable: true, mode: "push" }  
      },  
      modes: {  
        grab: { distance: 200, line\_linked: { opacity: 0.5 } }  
      }  
    }  
  });  
\</script\>

An architectural blueprint for the **Atomic Finds ATX** animated celestial background requires mapping furniture silhouettes into coordinates for a customizable HTML5 canvas framework.

Step-by-Step Animation Strategy

**1\. Define the Furniture Vector Coordinates**

Instead of utilizing standard particle clusters, you will program a custom set of geometric paths representing mid-century items (e.g., a Peacock wicker chair, a retro sunburst mirror, or a tapered sideboard).

* **Vector Grid**: Set up local arrays of relative X/Y coordinate pairs matching the key nodes/joints of your mockups.  
* **Default State**: Standard, slowly drifting background stars scattered randomly across the galaxy card setup.

**2\. The Celestial "Forming" Sequence**

Create a cycle where a subset of drift stars are systematically pulled into your target structural shapes via a smooth interpolation loop.

* **The Pull Phase**: When an item becomes featured or the user scrolls to a specific section, target background nodes transition their current floating positions to the nearest vector coordinates using a lerp() (linear interpolation) function.  
* **The Line Link**: As particles snap inside a specific proximity threshold of the furniture vector path, code the canvas to calculate connections and fade in sharp, micro-thin linking lines (opacity: 0.25).  
* **The Glow Phase**: Once fully locked into position, trigger a subtle pulsation filter on the core nodes to make the wicker loops or atomic legs appear as though they are actively glowing in deep space.

**3\. Interaction & Break-Apart Mechanics**

To keep the site layout highly performant and user-friendly, build an elegant exit mechanic.

* **Mouse Interaction**: Introduce a grab or repulse mouse-hover mechanic. If a user hovers directly over the newly formed star chair, the nodes react dynamically by slightly shifting away before snapping back.  
* **Scroll Trigger Breakout**: When the user scrolls past that product block, smoothly sever the vector ties. Accelerate the particle movement speeds briefly to let them explode back out into a natural, random drift constellation pattern.

Critical Implementation Details

* **Custom Geometric Paths**: The \<svg\> block inside the polygon.data field maps the strict path. If you change this out later for a **wicker teardrop chair** template from your mockups, you can drop your clean inline \<path\> strings right into that vector string block. \[[1](https://photos.google.com/link/photo?key=AF1QipOz8FlUUqgHc-tZ-5ngCr8FgPhGt-G2ApD2l_LG&obfsgid=102567003555056226475&utm_source=GM)\]  
* **The Equidistant Setting**: Stating arrangement: "equidistant" locks the drift particles down onto the custom vector framework so it holds a sharp shape rather than clustering randomly inside the volume.  
* **Mouse Grab Radius**: The interactivity.events.onHover.mode is specifically fine-tuned to "grab". Because text pointer fields are deactivated (pointer-events: none), passing your cursor over the constellation will actively pull local structural nodes tighter together to mimic a living web.

2\. Create the Client Component (/components/CelestialBackground.tsx)

Because canvas objects rely completely on browser APIs (window, document), this module must be configured strictly as a client component using "use client".

tsx  
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";  
import Particles, { initParticlesEngine } from "@tsparticles/react";  
import { loadAll } from "@tsparticles/all";  
import { loadPolygonMaskPlugin } from "@tsparticles/plugin-polygon-mask";  
import type { Engine } from "@tsparticles/engine";

export default function CelestialBackground() {  
  const \[init, setInit\] \= useState(false);

  useEffect(() \=\> {  
    // Engine setup initializes once on component mount  
    initParticlesEngine(async (engine: Engine) \=\> {  
      await loadAll(engine);  
      await loadPolygonMaskPlugin(engine);  
    }).then(() \=\> {  
      setInit(true);  
    });  
  }, \[\]);

  if (\!init) return \<div className="fixed inset-0 bg-\[\#0b0d19\]" /\>;

  return (  
    \<div className="fixed inset-0 w-full h-full z-10 pointer-events-auto bg-gradient-to-b from-\[\#16192b\] to-\[\#06070c\]"\>  
      \<Particles  
        id="tsparticles"  
        options={{  
          fpsLimit: 60,  
          particles: {  
            number: { value: 140 },  
            color: { value: "\#e2e8f0" },  
            shape: { type: "circle" },  
            opacity: {  
              value: { min: 0.3, max: 0.85 },  
              animation: { enable: true, speed: 1.5, sync: false }  
            },  
            size: { value: { min: 1, max: 2.5 } },  
            links: {  
              enable: true,  
              distance: 35,  
              color: "\#ffffff",  
              opacity: 0.25,  
              width: 1  
            },  
            move: {  
              enable: true,  
              speed: 0.6,  
              direction: "none",  
              random: true,  
              outModes: { default: "bounce" }  
            }  
          },  
          interactivity: {  
            events: {  
              onHover: {  
                enable: true,  
                mode: "grab" // Pulls localized star webs toward your cursor path  
              }  
            },  
            modes: {  
              grab: {  
                distance: 100,  
                links: { opacity: 0.55 }  
              }  
            }  
          },  
          polygon: {  
            enable: true,  
            type: "inline",  
            scale: 2.2, // Adjust scale factor to sizing needs  
            inline: { arrangement: "equidistant" },  
            draw: { enable: false },  
            move: { radius: 6 }, // Dictates the organic floating space vibration  
            // Coordinates representing a stylized vintage teardrop wicker chair frame  
            data: \`  
              \<svg xmlns="http://w3.org" viewBox="0 0 200 300"\>  
                \<\!-- Outermost Teardrop Wicker Frame Shell \--\>  
                \<path d="M 100,40 C 40,90 30,190 60,230 C 80,250 120,250 140,230 C 170,190 160,90 100,40 Z" /\>  
                \<\!-- Inner Seat Cushion Nesting Rim \--\>  
                \<path d="M 50,180 C 50,230 150,230 150,180 C 150,150 50,150 50,180 Z" /\>  
                \<\!-- Tapered Left Hairpin Leg \--\>  
                \<path d="M 65,225 L 45,280 L 80,235" /\>  
                \<\!-- Tapered Right Hairpin Leg \--\>  
                \<path d="M 135,225 L 155,280 L 120,235" /\>  
              \</svg\>  
            \`  
          }  
        }}  
      /\>  
    \</div\>  
  );  
}

      \<div className="relative z-20 flex flex-col justify-between min-h-screen p-6 md:p-12 pointer-events-none"\>  
          
        {/\* Header Metadata \*/}  
        \<header className="w-full flex justify-between items-center"\>  
          \<div className="flex flex-col gap-1"\>  
            \<span className="text-\[10px\] uppercase font-mono tracking-\[0.25em\] text-cyan-400 font-bold drop-shadow-sm"\>  
              Design System Preview // V1.0  
            \</span\>  
            \<h1 className="text-xl font-light tracking-widest text-slate-100 uppercase"\>  
              Atomic Finds ATX  
            \</h1\>  
          \</div\>  
          \<div className="hidden md:block text-right font-mono text-\[11px\] text-slate-500"\>  
            System Status: Interactive // Engine: tsParticles  
          \</div\>  
        \</header\>

        {/\* Hero Context Presentation \*/}  
        \<main className="max-w-md my-auto flex flex-col gap-4 select-none"\>  
          \<div className="inline-flex self-start rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-\[10px\] font-mono font-medium bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 backdrop-blur-md"\>  
            Active Layer: Background Mask  
          \</div\>  
          \<h2 className="text-3xl md:text-5xl font-extralight tracking-wide text-slate-200 leading-tight"\>  
            Animated \<span className="font-normal text-white drop-shadow-\[0\_0\_15px\_rgba(255,255,255,0.15)\]"\>{FURNITURE\_CONSTELLATIONS\[activeAsset\].name}\</span\> Sky  
          \</h2\>  
          \<p className="text-xs md:text-sm text-slate-400 leading-relaxed font-light"\>  
            Testing vector coordinate snapping parameters. Hover anywhere across the template wireframe to test responsive node-line cursor tracking.  
          \</p\>  
        \</main\>

        {/\* Interactive Workspace Controller (Click Actions De-isolated) \*/}  
        \<footer className="w-full flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4 justify-between items-start md:items-center pt-6 border-t border-slate-900 bg-slate-950/20 backdrop-blur-xs rounded-xl p-4 pointer-events-auto"\>  
          \<div className="flex flex-col gap-1"\>  
            \<span className="text-\[10px\] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500"\>  
              Select Preview Target Shape  
            \</span\>  
            \<div className="flex gap-2 mt-1"\>  
              \<button  
                onClick={() \=\> handleAssetSwap("chair")}  
                className={\`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg transition-all duration-200 border ${  
                  activeAsset \=== "chair"  
                    ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-950 border-white shadow-lg"  
                    : "bg-slate-900/80 text-slate-400 border-slate-800 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800"  
                }\`}  
              \>  
                Teardrop Chair  
              \</button\>  
              \<button  
                onClick={() \=\> handleAssetSwap("lamp")}  
                className={\`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg transition-all duration-200 border ${  
                  activeAsset \=== "lamp"  
                    ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-950 border-white shadow-lg"  
                    : "bg-slate-900/80 text-slate-400 border-slate-800 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800"  
                }\`}  
              \>  
                Tripod Lamp  
              \</button\>  
            \</div\>  
          \</div\>  
            
          \<div className="text-\[11px\] font-mono text-slate-400 max-w-xs leading-normal"\>  
            \<span className="text-slate-500 font-bold block mb-0.5"\>MOCKUP PARAMS\</span\>  
            Node Volume: 150 Particles \<br /\>  
            Drift Radius Constraint: 5px \<br /\>  
            Interaction Mode: Web Grab Loop  
          \</div\>  
        \</footer\>

      \</div\>  
    \</div\>  
  );  
}

Use code with caution.

Visual Validation Notes

* **Adaptive Control Deck**: The interactive footer buttons let you toggle instantly between shapes to contrast how tight vectors hold form versus how smooth loose lines drift.  
* **Layout Isolation**: The footer controls have pointer-events-auto mapped to allow structural clicks, while the rest of the layout relies on pointer-events-none so your cursor doesn't hit dead-zones while hovering over titles.
